profile.headline: SNHU fulltime Student and Insurance Claims Inspector
profile.summary: Originally from Wisconsin where I did my schooling and seven years in the Wisconsin Army National guard both as an Infantryman and a Supply Specialist.  Three of the most important qualities I learned and refined while in the military are Honesty, Integrity, and Teamwork. I'm excited to bring these qualities along with me in my work as I work in the insurance claims process that relies on integrity. I am a full-time student at SNHU where I'm completing my degree in General Studies with a concentration in Computer Coding Basics.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description: Here I've worked continually on my own side project. I've taught myself and implemented many new technologies to include cloud services such as Amazon Web Services (AWS: ec2 instance, RDS database, Amplify), web sockets for real time updates, reverse-proxy servers using Nginx, and SSL.

positions.title: Student of Coding Boot Camp
positions.description:
Full-time coding program, covered a full-stack. The curriculum taught the key skills for web development, including*:
Computer Science applied to JavaScript
Browser Based Technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery)
Deployment (Heroku, Git)
C# (ASP.Net)
Databases (MySQL, MongoDB)
Server Side Development (Node.js, Express, MERN Stack)
Quality Assurance

company.name: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

positions.title: Infantry Soldier and Supply Specialist
positions.description: I have served three years as an Infantryman, training with various light Infantry weapon systems and Tactics. Additionally, I am serving my last four years dealing with logistics, inventory, troop and supply transport as a supply specialist.

positions.title: OTR DRIVER
positions.description: Responsible for transport of Flatbed and Van loads from distribution center to retail stores. I was subject to DOT regulations in this job as a Class A OTR Driver.

positions.title: Self Employed
positions.description: Creating listings, Sourcing new products, Shipping orders, Maintaining inventory, Finding creative ways to lower costs, Responding to customers, Managing returns, and Keeping financial accounting were all responsibilities I had in successfully running this business. Gross Sales in my second year of 100K with an average profit margin from 20-30%.

volunteerExperiences.description:
I was responsible for ensuring the compliance of rules by guests staying in the shelter. Additionally, I would accept donations by the public and perform the initial questionnaire of incoming residents.

Additionally, I volunteered during fundraisers and would occasionally come serve meals outside of work hours.
